title: How do I identify which marketplace an order came from?

blocks.text: The order channel is shown on the Rynly Picking App home screen. Check whether the order is from Just Eat, Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Chop Chop before taking further action.
This matters because substitutions, extra-driver requests and other order actions can work differently for each channel.

blocks.alt: Order identifiers on the Rynly picking app home screen

title: How can I cancel an order?

blocks.text: Cancellation steps vary by marketplace and order state. Follow the current approved procedure for the channel shown on the order.

blocks.alt: Original Rynly instructions for cancelling an order

blocks.title: Need assistance?
blocks.text: Use Contact support to find the relevant marketplace support line. Do not assume the same cancellation workflow applies to every channel.

title: How can I pick multiple orders at the same time?

blocks.text: Batch picking lets eligible orders be picked together. The original Help Centre included a three-slide walkthrough; the screenshots can be restored below.

blocks.title: Before publishing
blocks.text: Review these slides against the latest batch-picking functionality and configuration.

title: How do I use pick scan / pack scan?

blocks.title: Selected stores only
blocks.text: This functionality only applies to stores where pick scan / pack scan has been enabled.

title: How do I clear an old or stuck order?

blocks.text: Select the affected order using the picking account assigned to it. Follow the on-screen guidance; all items should have an appropriate picked, unavailable or substituted state before the order is completed.

blocks.alt: Original example of resolving a hanging order

blocks.title: If the order remains stuck
blocks.text: Contact the relevant support team rather than repeatedly changing the order status without guidance.

title: What should I do with a Chop Chop payment failure?

blocks.text: Follow the payment-failure procedure for Chop Chop orders. The illustrated process from the previous Help Centre is reserved below.

blocks.title: Procedure review required
blocks.text: Confirm the current payment failure handling process with the responsible operational team before relying on this guide.

title: How do I stop on-demand orders at my store?

blocks.text: Follow your store's approved on-demand contingency procedure for the affected services.

blocks.label: Open Sainsbury's on-demand contingency procedure (requires access)

blocks.text: The previous Help Centre directs stores to the Just Eat and Deliveroo support lines where required, and to the JS Tech Service Desk for Chop Chop. For Uber Eats, it describes using the 'Take Store Offline' option in the Rynly app.

blocks.alt: Uber Eats Take Store Offline menu

blocks.title: Important
blocks.text: The Rynly support team cannot take a store offline from on-demand orders. Contact the appropriate marketplace support line or follow the approved contingency procedure.

title: How can I keep new-order alerts ringing?

blocks.text: The previous Help Centre recommends the following checks when device alerts are not ringing:

items: Check that both the handset and app volumes are set appropriately.
Keep the Rynly app open or running as required by the device configuration.
Do not force-close the app by swiping it away.
Check that the 'Rynly Hub Alerts Enabled' indication appears as expected on the device.

blocks.title: Still not receiving alerts?
blocks.text: Report the device and store details to the JS Tech Service Desk using the Contact support page.

title: How can I see which account is signed in on a device?

blocks.text: Open the account or settings area of the Rynly Picking App to check which picker account is active on the device.

blocks.alt: Rynly account settings and signed-in user

title: How do I request an extra driver for a large order?

blocks.text: The previous Help Centre states that the process differs by marketplace. Confirm the current policy before requesting additional courier capacity.
Just Eat
For large orders, an extra courier may be requested automatically, with Just Eat contacting the store. If a second courier does not arrive, contact Just Eat support.
Deliveroo
Contact Deliveroo support for assistance.
Uber Eats
Follow the marketplace-specific workflow illustrated in the original guidance.
Chop Chop
The old procedure describes requesting an additional driver after the original courier request becomes eligible. Verify the current trigger before using this process.

blocks.title: Who should I call?
blocks.text: Use Contact support to see the latest published partner numbers.
Choose the support team that matches your issue and marketplace. The Contact support page lists the numbers for Just Eat, Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Chop Chop and the JS Tech Service Desk.

blocks.title: Extra drivers or store availability
blocks.text: For these requests, contact the dedicated marketplace support line.
